statement: The singleton and finite-attainment conditions each agree with the Lomax sign criterion on observations.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (∀ {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < w i) → ∀ᵐ x : Fin n → ℝ ∂volume, (∀ i, 0 < x i) → (∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) → let y := expanded w x let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Lomax.logLik y p.1 p.2 let test := ∃ u ∈ Ioo 0 (Lomax.uBar y), Lomax.psi y u ≤ 0 ((∃! p, p ∈ Lomax.domain ∧ IsMaxOn L Lomax.domain p) ↔ test) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ Lomax.domain, IsMaxOn L Lomax.domain p) ↔ test)) ∧ (∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < x i) → (∃ a b : ℝ, ∀ i, x i = a ∨ x i = b) → let L := fun v : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Lomax.logLik x v.1 v.2 (∃ v ∈ Lomax.domain, IsMaxOn L Lomax.domain v) → ∃! v, v ∈ Lomax.domain ∧ IsMaxOn L Lomax.domain v) ∧ ( ∃! a, a ∈ Ioo ((2 : ℝ) ^ 512)⁻¹ ((2 : ℝ) ^ 32)⁻¹ ∧ let x : Fin 21 → ℝ := fun i ↦ if i.val = 0 then a else if i.val ≤ 10 then 1 else 100 ∃ p ∈ Lomax.domain, ∃ q ∈ Lomax.domain, p.2 < 1024 ∧ 1024 < q.2 ∧ IsMaxOn (fun v : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Lomax.logLik x v.1 v.2) Lomax.domain p ∧ IsMaxOn (fun v : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Lomax.logLik x v.1 v.2) Lomax.domain q ∧ (∀ b ∈ Lomax.domain, IsMaxOn (fun v : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Lomax.logLik x v.1 v.2) Lomax.domain b → b = p ∨ b = q) ∧ Lomax.bestExp x < Lomax.logLik x p.1 p.2)
dossier_scope_note: Fixed positive multiplicities and at least two distinct eligible levels in their own Lebesgue measure. Includes pointwise two-level uniqueness and the exact replicated tie.
